purpose: Retain all actual JSON/text/log reports, all Yongning study screenshots and actual browser downloads, and legacy failure screenshots from the production build, first live failure, and second live success. This is a scoped archive, not an archive of every old-feature screenshot or byte of the deployed site.
excluded_transport_zips: All six original ZIPs were actually downloaded and validated against GitHub size and SHA-256. ZIP transport containers are not duplicated in the long-term payload. Each member has its own byte count, SHA-256 and explicit retention decision.
focused_artifact_deduplication: Focused artifacts have been byte-compared against full artifacts and point to the one exact retained member path.
missing_historical_manual_session: No claim is made to recover the previous session's 49-file independent local verification or manual browser captures unless a separate extant original is supplied.

failure_evidence.report_contents: checks=[], errors=[], base_url only; the failure occurred before the script had saved its first screenshot
failure_evidence.raw_failure_traceback_source: Separate original GitHub job log, being collected by recovery agent; not inferred from empty report
